title: 2026 Q1~Q3 work review - Karen Shen

slides.title: 2026 Q1–Q3 Work Review
slides.notes: Open with the scope of this review: work recorded through September 21, focused on organizational contribution rather than a task inventory.

slides.title: Design Engineer turns design judgment into repeatable systems

content.statement: My role connects people, tools, and design standards—so AI-assisted work becomes usable, governable, and repeatable across the organization.

slides.notes: Frame the role as an organizational bridge. The value is not only output production; it is converting design knowledge into tools, workflows, and quality controls that others can use.

slides.title: The role operates through two bridges
slides.notes: Introduce the two operating lines first. The following slides show how each bridge produced reusable capabilities rather than isolated experiments.

slides.title: Designers ↔ AI workflow: make adoption practical and safe

columns.heading: Enable designers
bullets: Git / AI collaboration curriculum and bilingual guides
Repository architecture, setup, and recovery patterns

columns.heading: Operate the environment
bullets: AI access, model, credential, and profile management
Daily handoff, health check, and sync safeguards

slides.notes: Explain the bridge as both enablement and operational reliability. A training deck alone does not create adoption; designers also need safe access, relevant context, and dependable workflows.

slides.title: The workflow became shared capability, not one-off support

items.label: Projects aligned to shared AGENTS.md instructions

slides.notes: Use the numbers selectively. The aim is to demonstrate durable infrastructure: training, review quality gates, and compatible operating instructions across many project environments.

slides.title: The MKT workflow combines research, templates, and ready-to-use assets
slides.notes: Show the sequence behind MKT delivery: 85 images and 14 survey cards informed the design language; template guidance made that language reusable; the Figma export tool delivered 75 verified production assets.

slides.notes: Make internal work visible. Sharing and tools are leverage: they reduce repeated explanation, standardize quality, and allow design capability to travel between projects and teams.

slides.notes: These are not future ideas; they are active responsibilities with explicit next steps. This is important for reorg evaluation because the work includes continuing platform and operations ownership.

slides.title: Reorg implication: retain the bridge that makes design capability scalable

content.statement: The Design Engineer function connects design judgment with AI workflows and MKT delivery—while owning the systems that keep both reliable.

slides.notes: Close with the decision lens. The role holds a body of ongoing work that may be invisible if evaluation only counts final design artifacts: operating tools, standards, project pipelines, and cross-team handoff responsibility.
